resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says 1936; Forest Lookouts says 1938 for CCC erection. No third source found. The record uses the Register's 1936 and notes the Forest Lookouts date; the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Build year conflict: Register 1936 vs Forest Lookouts 1938. The Forest Lookouts page is short, with one dated line. The 2014 Forest Service record concerns a telecom tower at the Horn Mountain communications site and does not mention the fire tower, so it says nothing about whether the fire tower stands. Status is now unknown: the story no longer says the tower stands, since only the undated Pinhoti Trail listing (present tense) hints at it. A web search returned a Cheaha Mountain CCC stone tower (Bunker Tower), which is a different structure and was not used; a second search found no source for the 1938 CCC claim. Access level public reflects national forest land and a public trail; the story advises against climbing. The Skyway Motor Way wording and the Talladega County location were checked on the Register page on 2026-10-09 and are now quoted in evidence. No photos added. Not verified: staffing, fire history, cab condition, current access rules.
